question: Can we design a fruit fly that lives longer?

generations.asked: a fruit fly that lives longer
Drosophila melanogaster with wings and antennae that flies
the same fly, walking and flying
where this clade is recorded and what is recorded as eating it
does the design actually live longer -- in a vial, and where it lives?

chain.requirement: A longer intrinsic lifespan: the design must change the organism's own age-specific hazard rate, not merely its observed survival in a protected vial.
chain.species_caveat: Unusually for this project the proxy and the target are the same species: every link below is Drosophila melanogaster data, but it is laboratory-strain data (wDah, w1118, yw) from GAL4/GeneSwitch transgenics in vials, not from the designed construct, and several links are female-only.

missing_rungs.why: No source fetched in this run reports a hazard-RATE parameter for any of these genotypes. Every link except l15 reports median or maximum lifespan, and l15's statement ('reduced late age-specific mortality') is qualitative and was read in an abstract only. The run's performance layer needs an intrinsic hazard; nothing here supplies a number for it.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A demographic study fitting Gompertz (or Gompertz-Makeham) parameters A and B to large cohorts of a defined long-lived genotype and its matched control, with the fitted values reported, so that a genotype edit can be mapped to a change in baseline hazard rather than to a percentage change in median lifespan.

missing_rungs.why: On the strongest tissue-restricted arm (dFOXO in median neurosecretory cells, l08) the mediator is explicitly unknown: Alic 2014 found no significant change in dilp2, dilp3 or dilp5 mRNA, so the DILP2 route established in l05-l07 is not the route used there, and the signal is called 'as-yet-unidentified'.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: An unbiased secretome or haemolymph proteomic comparison of mNSC>dfoxo flies versus controls, followed by RNAi of each candidate in the mNSCs to test whether it is required for the lifespan extension.

missing_rungs.why: No direct biochemical demonstration of InR-to-dFOXO signalling in Drosophila was obtained. The canonical paper (Puig et al. 2003, Genes Dev) is not open access: Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 500 and the NCBI PMC efetch body states that the publisher does not allow full-text XML download. Jünger 2003 (l01, l03) is genetic epistasis plus localisation, not kinase biochemistry, and its 14-3-3 statement cites mammalian work.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Access to Puig et al. 2003 (or equivalent open-access Drosophila work) showing phospho-site-specific dFOXO regulation by dPKB/Akt downstream of InR, with reporter or ChIP evidence for the target genes.

missing_rungs.why: The whole TOR arm (l11-l13) has no cell, cell_cell, tissue or organ rung at all. Rapamycin was fed to whole animals and the 4E-BP null is constitutive and ubiquitous. Nothing fetched in this run places TOR-dependent lifespan control in a named Drosophila tissue.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Tissue-restricted, adult-onset TORC1 manipulation (for example fat-body-, gut- or neuron-specific Tor RNAi or Rheb/TSC manipulation under GeneSwitch control) with lifespan readout.

missing_rungs.why: The 'cell' rung is never actually resolved to cells. Every fat-body result is qPCR, western blot or immunoassay on dissected tissue or whole flies, with the cell type inferred from a GAL4 driver's reported expression pattern rather than measured per cell.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Single-cell or single-nucleus RNA-seq of adult fat body and brain under the same dfoxo induction, so that the responding cell populations (and the fraction of them responding) are measured rather than assumed from a driver.

missing_rungs.why: Nothing fetched connects any of this mechanism to EXTRINSIC mortality. The run's performance layer caps expected life in the wild at 12.5 days through extrinsic hazard; every experiment cited here was done in vials with food, no predation and no weather, so the ladder explains only the intrinsic term and cannot predict the 1.09x wild outcome.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Field or mesocosm survival data for a reduced-IIS Drosophila genotype against a matched control under natural extrinsic mortality, or at minimum a laboratory hazard decomposition under imposed extrinsic mortality.

missing_rungs.why: Sex specificity is unexplained and unmodelled. Giannakou 2004 reports fat-body dFOXO extends female but not male life-span, Bai 2012's dilp6 effects are female-only, Alic 2014's experiments are female-only, and Bjedov 2010 reports a smaller rapamycin effect in males. A design requirement stated as 'a longer lifespan' is therefore under-specified.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Matched male and female cohorts for each tissue-restricted intervention, and a mechanistic account of the sex difference (for example whether the fat-body-to-brain DILP6/DILP2 circuit operates in males at all).

missing_rungs.why: ADDED BY VERIFICATION. The cell_cell -> tissue rung is circular and reverses direction. l05 leaves the fat body cell (CL_0000565) and lands on the fat-body-to-IPC interaction; l06 then lands that interaction back on FBbt_00003209, adult fat body - the same tissue the walk departed from one rung earlier - and points the arrow fat-body-ward, against the fat-body -> brain direction of l05 and l07. So the walk formally advances a level while physically standing still, and the single link that carries the whole ladder across this level (l06, Hwangbo 2004) is 'abstract only' because the paper is not open access. Every other rung on the walkable path has full text behind it; this one does not.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A full-text, tissue-restricted source whose cell-cell step lands on a tissue the chain has not already used - for example a brain or neurosecretory-tissue readout downstream of the fat body DILP6 signal - so that the cell_cell rung carries the walk forward rather than back onto its own origin.

missing_rungs.why: ADDED BY VERIFICATION. FBbt_00003209 (adult fat body) occupies BOTH the tissue rung (l06 target, l07 source) and the organ rung (l09 source). One ontology id standing at two consecutive levels means the tissue -> organ step is not a real level transition for the fat body arm; l09's note states the fly fat body is both, but the consequence - that the ladder has six distinct entities across seven rungs - was not recorded as a break.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Either a source that resolves the fat body into a sub-tissue with its own id (adult head / pericerebral versus abdominal fat body; the pericerebral term was searched for in ubergraph_labels4.json and not found), or an explicit decision to collapse tissue and organ into one rung for this organism and re-state the ladder as six levels.

verification.posture: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
verification.method: Four Python scripts over runs/_chains/long-lived-fruit-fly.json, runs/_chains/log/long-lived-fruit-fly.fetch.json and every file in runs/_chains/raw/long-lived-fruit-fly/. Quote matching normalised whitespace and the unicode quote/dash/nbsp variants only, then searched each quote_from file twice: once in the raw bytes and once with all XML tags stripped, so a quote spanning inline italic tags passes on visible text. No quote was accepted on inspection.

checks.quotes_matched: 17 of 17 links verified. Every quote was found in BOTH the raw bytes and the tag-stripped text of the file named in quote_from. 0 failures, so 0 links deleted.
checks.fetch_log: 17 of 17 quote_from files appear in the fetch log with status 200 and a sha256. No link cites a file that was not logged, and no link cites the two blocked Puig fetches, which are honestly confined to refused_sources.
checks.source_binding: Checked that each quote sits inside the article it is attributed to, not merely inside the file. pm_classics.xml and pm_classics2.xml were split per <PubmedArticle> and each quote matched the claimed PMID: l16->11292874, l09->15192154, l06->15175753, l15->11292875. Every PMC full text carries the claimed PMID in its own article-meta.
checks.grades: All 17 graded against the table in genotype/AGENT_BRIEF.md. 2 downgraded (see below). 15 stand, including the epistasis-based `mechanism` grades on l02, l03, l11 and l13, which the brief explicitly admits as mechanism, and the loss-of-function `necessity` grades on l07, l12, l14, l15, l16 and l17.
checks.walkability: Every adjacent rung pair has at least one link and the ids chain continuously: UniProt:Q95V55 -> GO_0008286 (l01) -> CL_0000565 (l04) -> CL_0000565+CL_0000168 (l05) -> FBbt_00003209 (l06) -> FBbt_00003624 (l07) -> GO_0008340 (l08). The ladder is therefore formally walkable end to end on the insulin arm, but see the two breaks added to missing_rungs: the cell_cell -> tissue rung returns to its own origin, and one id stands at two levels. The TOR arm (l11-l13) and the five whole-animal shortcuts (l13-l17) declare their skipped rungs honestly and were not counted as hidden breaks.
checks.holdout: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
checks.identifiers: CLEAN. All 27 logged URLs and the two POST bodies were scanned for e-mail addresses, for email/tool/api_key/token/user/uid/account/login/access_token/auth query parameters, for the account holder's name and domains, and for long hex strings. No match. The NCBI eutils calls carry no tool= or email= parameter at all, which is an NCBI politeness omission but the opposite of a leak.

downgraded.why: The quote is the second half of a model statement. The sentence immediately before it in ft_PMC333403.xml is 'In summary, our overexpression experiments are consistent with a model in which...'. A modelled claim is `hypothesis` under the brief, not a shown pathway step, and the quote also attributes the translocation jointly to human hFOXO3a.

Abstract-only gain of function. Activating dFOXO in pericerebral fat body lowers dilp-2 expression and represses insulin-dependent signalling: 'gain of function changes it' = `sufficiency`. No binding, reporter, epistasis, rescue or recording is in the quotable text, and the full text was never obtained.

The fetched PubMed record for that PMID gives 10.1126/science.1057991. 10.1126/science.1057987 is the DOI of PMID 11292875, the Tatar paper cited in l15, so the two links currently share one DOI and l16's is wrong. The link's own note said the DOI 'should be re-checked'; it is now checked against the saved bytes and it is incorrect.

defects_found_but_outside_the_verifier_e.what: l01 and l03 record journal 'BMC Biology' and doi 10.1186/1741-7007-1-2 for Junger 2003. The fetched PMC full text gives journal-title 'Journal of Biology' and doi 10.1186/1475-4924-2-20. Journal of Biology was later absorbed into BMC Biology, but the DOI on record does not resolve to this paper.

Six quotes (l02, l04, l07, l08, l10, l17) are mid-sentence fragments whose grammatical subject or object lies outside the quoted span. Each is faithful to its context and each what_it_does_not_show explains the inline-markup reason, but as quotable lines they do not stand alone: l02's quote never names what blocked the extension (it was mutation of dfoxo), and l04's stops before naming the readout (dilp6 mRNA in adult fat body).

Relation and grade disagree on l06, l09 and l10, all of which assert relation 'required_for' while the evidence is gain of function graded `sufficiency`. An overexpression result cannot show requirement. l08 has the same mismatch.

verification.not_softened: No existing entry in missing_rungs was weakened or removed. The seven gaps the builder declared - absent hazard-rate parameters, the unidentified mediator on the l08 arm, the missing InR-to-dFOXO biochemistry, the anatomy-free TOR arm, the cell rung never resolved to cells, the untouched extrinsic-mortality term, and the unexplained sex specificity - were each checked against the sources and all seven stand as written.
